boundary_evidence: Opening, continuations and actual ending of one complete publisher-issued notice/filing, including all integrated sections. No invented scope.
notice_identity: Issuer, title, rule/docket, issuance/hearing/proceeding identity and source URL; preserve ambiguity.
dedup_evidence: Prior inventory original hash plus underlying issuer/title/rule/docket/date/source/page identity comparison, including current retained notices.
stratum_basis: Natural source condition on comment submission timing or hearing availability/request threshold, conditional cancellation of a proposed-rule hearing, or event-relative participation timing. A generic submission-format practicability qualifier, accessibility request, possible later rule modification or incidental quoted statute alone does not qualify. Fixed written-comment dates may coexist with a conditional hearing. No negative lifecycle-only controls in this round.
